subject: The secret 90% of users miss about meeting notes
preview_text: I discovered something about your notes that changes everything. Most people skip this one thing and regret it later.
body_paragraphs: I was reviewing how people use Smart Notes and noticed a pattern. The users who save the most time—the ones who actually stop writing and start listening—all do one specific thing. And I noticed you haven't tried it yet.

Here's the truth: most people download the app, use the transcription, and think they're done. But they're missing the entire point. The real magic happens AFTER the meeting ends. That's when you either waste hours organizing or reclaim your entire afternoon.

The feature you're sleeping on? Smart search across ALL your notes. It's not just a search bar. It's like having a photographic memory for every conversation you've ever had. Find that one action item from three weeks ago in two seconds. Connect ideas across different projects without digging through files.

Open the app right now and type one keyword into the search bar. See what surfaces. I'll wait. P.S. The 100+ professionals saving 5+ hours weekly? They use search 3x more than average users. Your past meetings are a goldmine—you just need to know how to mine them.
